name: Forbidden pc-Minor Characterization
statement: An ample class is spread ample exactly when it has no pc-minor isomorphic, up to coordinate permutations, coordinate flips, and deletion of constant coordinates, to a pc-minor-minimal non-spread ample class.
comments: The basis is defined intrinsically and may be infinite. The manuscript classifies it through five coordinates and gives further six-coordinate members, but does not claim a complete explicit enumeration.
